LESSON: SELF-AWARENESS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: MYSELF Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experienc
Topic 2.1: Self-awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Self-awareness, part of MYSELF Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experienc in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to know yourself?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Self-awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self –efficacy: knowing who I am as the learner tells whether he or she is a boy or a girl

• Communication and collaboration; Speaking as the learner tells work done by boys and girls in school and at home in groups

then to the whole class.

Values:
• Respect is developed as the learner waits patiently to tell name, gender and what is liked most.

• Responsibility as the learner identifies work done at home by boys and girls.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
.

• Citizenship is enhanced as the learner becomes aware of the right to a name and appreciation of gender roles.

• Self-awareness as a life skill is enhanced as the learner correctly identifies self-using name, gender and ability.

Link to other Learning Areas: Environmental activities as the learner listens to rhymes on self-awareness touching on name,

gender and work liked.

Suggested learning resources: Clothes, recorded rhymes
